title: Bee Removal Upper West Side
metaDescription: Professional wasp, hornet, yellow jacket, and carpenter bee removal in Upper West Side, Manhattan. Licensed technicians. Call (855) 930-5016.
intro: The Upper West Side's tree-lined streets and historic brownstones provide beautiful living spaces, but they also attract wasps, hornets, yellow jackets, and carpenter bees seeking nesting sites in walls, eaves, soffits, and window frames. The Best Pest Control NYC offers professional stinging insect removal services throughout the Upper West Side, from Riverside Drive to Central Park West — identifying the species, treating active nests in wall voids and structural wood, removing nest material, and sealing entry points to prevent recolonization.
whyUs: Our licensed technicians have extensive experience working in Upper West Side's diverse architecture, from pre-war co-ops to classic brownstones. We provide same-day service throughout the neighborhood and use eco-friendly methods that protect both your property and the local ecosystem, with pricing transparent from $350-$550 depending on colony size and location.
localContext: Upper West Side residents near landmarks like the American Museum of Natural History, Lincoln Center, and Riverside Park often encounter stinging insect activity during warmer months, particularly in garden-level apartments, rooftop spaces, and the eaves of brownstones. The neighborhood's abundant green spaces and flowering gardens attract wasps and yellow jackets to build paper nests in soffits, attics, and wall voids, while carpenter bees bore galleries into exposed wood trim and railings. Wasp and hornet colonies grow rapidly through summer, and a nest inside a wall cavity can house thousands of defenders by August.

faqs.question: How much does wasp and hornet nest removal cost in the Upper West Side?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the nest location, access, and severity — call (855) 930-5016 for a free phone quote and a clear price before any work begins.

faqs.question: Do you treat honeybees in the Upper West Side?
faqs.answer: No, we do not treat honeybees. If an inspection confirms a colony is honeybees rather than wasps or hornets, we refer the situation to a licensed beekeeper instead of treating it ourselves.

faqs.question: Do you remove wasp and hornet nests from Upper West Side brownstones and pre-war buildings?
faqs.answer: Yes, we specialize in stinging insect removal from all Upper West Side building types, including historic brownstones, pre-war co-ops, and modern high-rises. Our licensed technicians are experienced in working with older architecture and take care to locate the nest inside wall voids, treat it through the entry point, and seal openings to prevent recolonization.

faqs.question: How quickly can you respond to a wasp or hornet problem in the Upper West Side?
faqs.answer: We offer same-day service throughout the Upper West Side. Most calls are responded to within hours, and we understand the urgency when an active nest threatens families in densely populated residential areas near schools and parks. Call (855) 930-5016 for immediate scheduling.
